Subject: Kickoff: MAP + Legal/Procurement Orientation for StellarBiz Pilot

Hi Laura and Josh,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to get the StellarHealth pilot live. I've attached a first-pass MAP and an evaluation plan spreadsheet to make sequencing transparent.

High-level suggested timeline (open to adjustments):
- Discovery / SOW finalization: 05/03 - 05/10
- Eval & performance checks: 05/11 - 05/20
- Legal review & redlines: 05/21 - 05/25
- Signature & kickoff: target 05/26

What I need from you to get this moving:
1) Please confirm who on your side is the procurement owner and who will own legal/contract review.
2) Any mandated procurement steps or PO requirements we should plan for (procurement portal, W9, standard terms)?
3) Are there any security/compliance artifacts you need up front (SOC 2 report, encryption details)?

Action: If you can reply with names and preferred calendar time for a 30-min contracting sync this week, I will loop in our contracts lead and propose the redline cadence.

Sanjay / Stellar procurement — great to meet you over email. Laura looped you in; thanks for taking this on.

Marissa Cole is our contracts lead (marissa.cole@redwood.com) and will be the primary owner for redlines and finalizing terms. Karthik Iyer (cc) will be our technical lead for the evaluation and can help scope the SOW items.

Couple of notes on process so expectations are aligned:
- Initial redline turnaround: we aim to provide an internal response within 72 business hours of receiving your redline PDF or Word.
- Preferred format: redlines in MS Word with tracked changes; if you provide a vendor markup PDF we'll convert and respond but Word saves time.
- Standard exceptions we flag early: data residency clauses, liability caps, and indemnity. If you have non-negotiable procurement terms, flag those now so we can escalate.
- DocuSign: once both parties are aligned, we'll send via DocuSign for signature.

Attached: SOW draft (SOW_Draft_Stellar.docx) and a versioned MAP. Also linking the HubSpot deal for internal tracking.

Proposed contracting milestones (subject to your confirmation):
- 05/06: contracting sync (legal + procurement)
- 05/10: Redwood sends updated SOW + any requested security artifacts
- 05/21: first redline complete by Stellar; Redwood counter by 05/24
- 05/26: target signature

If that timeline looks tight on your side, let us know which milestone you want to relax. We'll keep to the target but can shift if you need more review time.
